    "A": "Porting the proven v0 SectionNav maintains the scroll-spy UX we already validated and keeps work scoped to styling updates only.",
    "B": "The 3-step form mirrors the highest-converting v0 pattern and keeps cognition manageable while still allowing us to insert the calculator feedback per C14.",
    "C": "Reference cards plus the schedule/cost narrative gives architects both compliance proof and a Plycem-safe value context without waiting on video approvals.",
    "E": "A slim four-document set removes the Plycem-branded assets, reduces maintenance, and still covers the critical certs (UL, ASTM, IAPMO, tech sheet).",
    "F": "Ship the single-page version now and plan per-city expansions later so we have an SEO foothold without blocking launch on 5x content writing.",
    "J": "A full three-part CSI spec is the authoritative deliverable specifiers expect and remains feasible within Sprint 5 effort.",
    "P": "A `/pricing` stub with copy steering users to quote requests keeps the URL alive for direct traffic while staying SB-4 compliant.",
    "R": "A dedicated /installation route is a single canonical surface covering all product families and avoids duplicating content across six PDPs.",
    "T": "Cloudflare Turnstile provides modern bot resistance with minimal friction and is already supported in our Cloudflare stack.",
    "V": "Highlighting ER-360 both on the home TrustBar and the pillar gives the cert maximum visibility for specifiers landing on either surface.",
    "Y": "Adding the CLI lint hook keeps DESIGN.md authoritative without the heavier Tailwind auto-export plumbing for this launch timeline."
  },
  "additional_findings": [
    {
      "title": "Turnstile token verification on Cloudflare/Next API routes",
      "description": "When adopting T2, ensure the server-side verification hits `https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify` from the API route running under OpenNext/Workers and that the response handling treats `cdata` and `hostname` mismatches as failures; otherwise a misconfigured site key could silently pass traffic.",
      "severity": "medium",
      "applies_to_phase": "4"
    }
  ],
  "verdict": "ship",
  "verdict_reason": "The selected options prioritize proven patterns, minimize new dependencies, and keep Sprint 4/5 scoped tightly enough to maintain the launch-in-days mandate while still covering spec-critical content."
}
